verdict.rationale: SumUp's documented Cloud API lets a POS on any platform start and manage transactions on Solo/Go readers via HTTPS requests. It supports pairing and naming multiple readers, simultaneous transactions with no distance limit, and a Virtual Solo plus sandbox account for testing the pairing and checkout flow. This is exactly a server-driven terminal checkout API. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Cloud API terminal flow, and documented terminal-transaction status callbacks or result handling (the webhook docs cover only online checkout status changes).
